messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in place and slowly rotates a full 360 degrees, turning from facing forward to the side, then to the back, and finally back to the front.","camera":"A medium full-body shot at eye level, with the camera orbiting around the character to follow his rotation.","clothing":"A dark grey military-style uniform with a high collar, gold buttons, a gold belt, and white stripes down the sides of the trousers, paired with black shoes and a pink beret.","hair_color":"Pink","hairstyle":"Short hair, mostly covered by a cap.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build, light skin, and a short dark beard.","scene":"An outdoor courtyard with cracked stone paving, surrounded by tan stone buildings, wooden crates, and a red bench in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The dark neon-lit interior was replaced with a sunlit outdoor courtyard containing cracked stone paving, tan buildings, wooden crates, and a red bench. The character remains in the same uniform and pink beret, performs the same slow 360-degree rotation, and the camera continues orbiting around him. Lighting on the character changed from cool neon to warm daylight.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the futuristic indoor environment with the outdoor stone courtyard from the reference, changing only the environment and its lighting on the person while preserving identity, appearance, expression, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the final courtyard matches the exact reference camera framing and all background details, since the character occludes part of the scene.
unexpected_changes: The character's uniform appears lighter grey in daylight, though this is consistent with the requested lighting change.
